import pandas as pd
d=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d=d[d.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy();d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date,format='%m/%d/%y')
for c in ['cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    p=d.groupby(['date',c]).unblended_cost.sum().unstack().fillna(0)
    t=p.loc['2025-10-20'];b=p.loc['2025-10-13':'2025-10-19'].mean()
    print((t-b).sort_values().tail(4))
